fact: On 18 September 2024 the Adentan Circuit Court ordered Bolt Holdings OU to pay GH₵1.9 million in compensatory damages for breaching sections 20, 21, 28 and 30 of the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).
title: Bolt Holdings OU ordered to pay GH₵1.9m after passenger finds his photo as driver in ride request
